description: Check if a secret exists without retrieving it. Does not require vault to be unlocked.
embedding_description: Vault: check whether a secret exists. Returns a boolean for a given vault key without revealing the secret value (credential, password, OAuth client_secret, API key, refresh token, bearer token). Does NOT require unlocking — only metadata is consulted, not the encrypted bytes. Use to gate workflows that should run only when a credential is already provisioned.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Boolean existence check result. Contains key (identifier) and exists (true/false). Does not expose any secret data.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Checks if a secret key exists in the vault. Does not require unlocking - only checks metadata.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultNotInitialized: Vault has not been set up yet. StorageError: Unable to read from vault storage backend.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultNotInitialized: Guide user through vault initialization. For StorageError: Check storage backend health and permissions.
